title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (October 2026)
summary: This is a Hacker News "Who is hiring?" monthly thread for October 2026, containing 221 job postings and 227 points. It provides community guidelines for employers (state location, REMOTE/ONSITE, no recruiters) and links to third-party job-search tools. The content is a job board rather than technical AI/ML material, though many listed roles likely involve AI/ML engineering.
